clean.tl: Then I decided to … talk a bit about … my childhood, and then especially when I was together with my grandfather up in Pardatsch.

clean.tl: Those relatives who lived in Surrein were very poor, they would save as much as they could, they had to save, and … I know from my uncles, they had a rather … small farm, what could they have, maybe ten, fifteen big animals and then also goats I know they had, and … pigs and hens and such things, and lived rather on farming.

clean.tx: A zatgéj mava' lṣ aucs mavan lu aun anzatgé … ád uáut.
clean.tl: And sometimes my uncles would also go sometimes … to the forest.

clean.tx: Ábar i èra, a fá léna, cunzún al bjè a fá léna né a métar najf magari i è stau in tjams tga mavan sél pas, mávani sé a métar najf pala … viafíar da la Fùrca
clean.tl: But it was in order to fell trees, especially in most cases to fell trees or to remove snow from time to time, it was a time when they would go up to the pass, they used to go up to remove snow for the … Furka-Alpsu railway line.

clean.tx: A lu … tiar mè ṣè quaj stau ussuschéa, ju èr’ juṣ ah … a scùlèta.
clean.tl: And then with me it was exactly like this; I had gone to nursery school.

clean.tl: Here we had a Sister who used to teach around, right in front of here, around fifty children.

clean.tx: Álṣò qu’ èra fòrs’ ina tjarza tga mava a scùlèta.

clean.tx: Ju sùn juṣ in tjamṣ a plaṣchèva da mé ṣchùbar nuét api vau détg di mùma in dé:

clean.tx: «Ju cala dad í a scùlèta, ju pùs bitg' í plé.»

clean.tx: Quaj è quèla val, gjù cò la val Nalbṣ vidajn, in majṣès ajnami̱az c' ò nùm Pardatsch.
clean.tl: This is the valley down here, into the Nalps valley, a majṣés.

clean.tx: Lu sùnd ju sadacidjus dad í, gè gè vau tartgau, ju sùn adina staus plétò̱st al tüp da la … natira.
clean.tl: Then I decided to go, yes, yes, I thought I had always been rather someone who likes nature.

clean.tx: Sùnd juṣ ah gjù Surajn a lò ṣè aun stau … da fá laṣ davùsas lavurs, scù métar grascha, ará a da quaj, quaj èra bigja grat schi sémpal, a sjantar èssan nuṣ i … ajn quaj Pardatsch.
clean.tl: I went eh down to Surrein and there we still had … to do the last work, like dunging, ploughing and this sort of thing, this was not exactly that simple, and after that we went up to Pardatsch.

clean.tx: Í vidajn, quaj manava aun ina … ina via nauscha, ábar i èran grad vitlúndar, vida luvará, qu’ è stau al tjams tschuncòntassís, ju vèva … siṣ òns tga … èran vida prapará la via par í sé Nalps a bagagè al mir da farmada.
clean.tl: go up, there led a … a bad road, but they were just working, that was … in 1956, I was six years old when they were preparing the road in order to go to Nalps to build the wall of the reservoir.

clean.tx: Ah … Nalps è vagnú fraquantau ò scù majṣès ad alps adina, lu ṣè aun dus trajs intarassants lògans ajn cò, ajn Burganèz, qu' è in tòc pléndanòra, lò ani bagagjau gjù la … raquéntani … la crapa par bagagè al clutgèbasèlgja.
clean.tl: Eh … Nalps has always been visited as an assembly of houses and as pastures, there are furthermore two or three interesting places up there, in Burganez, this is a little bit more down the valley, there they removed, as they say, the stones used to build the church tower .

clean.tx: Quèla blòca mávani ajn a tagliavan ò a trèvan vidò cun bùfs tòcan ò cò a Sadrùn.
clean.tl: these blocks they went up, cut out, and brought them down with oxen until here in Sedrun.

clean.tx: A pléndanajn in tòc da tschèla vart, lò ṣaj práctisch al sulèt grép da catschina tga végn avaun ála val Tujetsch.
clean.tl: And a little bit more uphill, a little bit on the other side, there is almost the only limestone rock that can be found in the Tujetsch valley.

clean.tx: Ad i aun èra lò, zatgé rastònza ṣè aun lò tg’ ins sa í ajn a mirá; `l PN ò è fagj lò in pèr placats tga mùssan ajn via nùc’ ins sa è mirá quaj.
clean.tl: And there were also, there still are some remnants there where one can go and see; PN also put some posters there which show where on the way one can have a look at this.

clean.tx: A lu Pr̩datsch … plénansé cò ancù̱ntar Tgòm … ṣaj ina rùsna, quaj fùṣ è aun intarassant sch’ ins savés, quaj datèscha da gl òn ju … a ùssa bigja grat prèsèn, méli a sistschian a zatgéj.
clean.tl: And then Pardatsch … a bit more uphill here in direction of Tgom … there is a cave, it would indeed be interesting if one knew, this is dated, I … don't have it exactly in mind, sixteen hundred something.

clean.tx: A lò pratjándani tga cavavan òra … matalts.
clean.tl: And there they pretend that they recovered metals.

clean.tx: A quaj è ina rùsna, òh tgé pù qual' èssar … in mè̱tar a miaz … lada, a fòrza … dus mè̱tars auta.
clean.tl: And there is a cave, oh how big may it be …, one and a half metres … wide, and maybe … two metres high.

clean.tx: Daváuntiar ṣaj sé la, l’ anada cur' i òn antschiat, ad inṣ vèz’ aun quaj, bagagjávani gjù … cun ah, bjè manuálmajn.
clean.tl: In front of it there is, eh, the year when they started, one can still see they used to mine this with, ah, a lot manually.

clean.tx: Lèdṣ vèva lu dau zatgéj étg dad úndṣchar ajn a faschas a la tata ò lu aun détg da mé:
clean.tl: He had given some ointment to rub in and bandages, and then my grandmother said to me:

clean.tx: «Té mira lu tg’ al tat fétschi lu mintga dé, prèndi gjù quaj a ṣchubrègi a fétschi sé da néjf.»
clean.tl: And you, make sure that your grandfather does it every day, that he takes them off, that he cleans them and puts them on again.

clean.tx: «Gè gè gè quaj vi ju schòn … mirá tga végni fatg.»
clean.tl: Yes of course, I will make sure that'll be done.

clean.tx: A … grat par finí quèla istòrja, qu’ è lu ju … quèluísa, ju ṣchèva mintgataun dal tat:
clean.tl: And … in order to conclude this story, it went in the following way: I said from time to time to my grandfather:

clean.tx: «Té … Vajs fatg èl?»
clean.tl: You … Did you do it?

clean.tx: Lu ṣchèv’ inṣ aun Vuṣ da … ah, da tat a tata vau adina détg Vuṣ, ábar dals, méjs gjaniturs … vajn nuṣ ùssa bégja détg Vus, ábar i èra bjèrs tga … òn détg tòcan, gè práctiṣch adina Vus dals gjaniturs.
clean.tl: At that time, one used to say Vus to … eh, to my grandfather and my grandmother I have always said Vus, but to the, my parents … we never said Vus, but there were many who have said until, well practically always Vus to their parents.

clean.tx: «Gè gè quaj è schòn bian.»
clean.tl: Yes, sure, that’s OK.

clean.tx: Scha vèva `l fatg ṣchùber nuét.
clean.tl: But he hadn’t done anything at all.

clean.tx: Quèla fascha èra satratg’ anzjaman, a vidajn ála pjal, carschid’ ajn ála pjal api ò `l stju í ò tial dòctar.
clean.tl: That bandage had contracted, and into the skin, grown into the skin and then he had to go to the doctor.

clean.tx: Ajnta Pardadṣch vèvan nus circa déjsch, èba déjsch quéndisch tgauṣ grònṣ api vèvan nus tgauraṣ a pòrs.
clean.tl: Up in Pardatsch we had about ten, as already mentioned ten or fifteen large farm animals, and we had goats and pigs.

clean.tx: A lu mia lavur èra … èra bitga atgnamajn da fá bjè, a quaj tg’ èra da parvaj aun djantarájn fagèv’ al tat, api vèvanṣ da partgirá als tiars, mav’ ins lò sédòr ál sit, grat cò nùca quèla rùsna tgu a raquintau.
clean.tl: And my work was, was … not exactly to do a lot, and what still had to be fed in between, my grandfather would do, and we also had to mind the animals; we would then go up to the south, just by that cave I have mentioned.

clean.tx: Quaj sch’ i dèva rèsts, scha vagnévi lu magari rimnau quaj dus trajs diṣ api méz tùt ajn ina … tùt anzjaman.
clean.tl: Well, when there were leftovers, they would sometimes be collected for two or three days and then put all together in a … all together.

clean.tx: A sjantar tschajnas, gljèz, quaj èra schòn è aun léjgar.
clean.tl: And after dinner, well, this was also funny.

clean.tx: Sjantar tschajna mav’ inṣ ajn, quaj èr’ èr, èls èran rèligjúṣ, èra quaj nùndétg.
clean.tl: After dinner we would go in, this was also, they were religious, this was indescribable.

clean.tx: Vagnévi ju ajn ajn nuégl, parquaj tga … l’ antschata da la parmavèra stuèv’ ins schè ajn als tiarṣ ajn nuégl, a lu máv’ inṣ ajn api ṣchèva `l:
clean.tl: When they entered the barn, because … at the beginning of spring one had to let the animals into the barn, and then one would enter and then he would say:

clean.tx: «Sò, ùsa ṣchajn nuṣ impau patarnòṣ.» ad èl samatév’ adina giùdajn.
clean.tl: «OK, now we will say some Lord’s prayer» and he would always sit down in .

clean.tx: Suschéa sasév’ ajn ajn purṣèpan, a … èl dad ina vart ad ju da tschèla vart, a quaj ṣchèva `l trajs quátar patarnòṣ a vònzaj èri «Sòntga Maria Mùma da Dju» api èra `l navèn.
clean.tl: So he would sit in the manger, and … he on the one side and I on the other side, and so he would say three or four Lord’s prayers and a bit later «Holy Mary Mother of God», and then he was gone.

clean.tx: Sadurmantav’ ajn. A lu dumagnav’ ju bigja nònavaun èl.
clean.tl: He would fall asleep.

clean.tx: Ṣùtajn èri la tégja nùca `l caṣchav' èra, daspèras quèls dus nuégls api stuèv' inṣ í ò ad í sé sén clavau, a lò èri ajn ina stiva sc’ ins ṣchèva, ajn quèls majṣès ṣchèv’ ins la stiva nùc’ ins durméva.
clean.tl: Below was the alpine hut where he would also make cheese, next to it those two cow barns and one must go out and up into the hay barn, and therein was the stiva, the living room, as they used to say, in those majṣés the room where one slept was called stiva.

clean.tx: Ad ju mava lu sé lò durmí, ábar ah, bjè nòtgs staus parsuls sé lò, ha, a lò vòu schòn ah … gju inqual tèma.
clean.tl: And I used to go up there to sleep, but, eh, many nights I was alone up there, ha, and there I was eh sometimes afraid.

clean.tx: Ajn quèla végljadé̱tgna, api al pròblè̱m èra, èra, al pròblè̱m èra las sòndaṣ a dumèngjas.
clean.tl: At that age, and the problem was, was, the problem was on Saturdays and Sundays.

clean.tx: Né al vèndardís sèra, quèls taljans, quaj èra práctisch mù taljans tga luvravan cò vid la via.
clean.tl: Or Friday evening, these Italians, there were practically only Italians who worked on the road.

clean.tx: Sòndadumèngja vagnévan quèls ò cò a fagjèvan fjastunas.
clean.tl: On weekends they would come here and have big parties.

clean.tx: A magari tga pudèvan lu bigja … vidajn a … vajn gju in pèr jèdas quèls tga vagnévan, u tga vagnévan ajn ál clavau a durmévan, ábar è ál légj dal tat … sùnd ju è schòn sadastadaus tg' i èr' ajn … in né dus taljánars tga durmévan.
clean.tl: Now sometimes they couldn’t manage … to come … into and … we sometimes had those who came or who came into the barn and slept , but I happened to wake up there when one or two Italians were sleeping .

clean.tx: Òh, lu schòn tumju in pau mintgataun.
clean.tl: Oh, really afraid sometimes.

clean.tx: Pr̩quaj tga quaj c’ ins … vèva bigja grad da partgirá tiars sch’ èr’ inṣ antir dé cun quèls, qu' èra è intarassant da mirá c’ i luvravan, c' i bagagjavan gjù.
clean.tl: Because when we … didn’t just have to mind the animals, we were with them the whole day; it was also interesting to watch when they were working, when they would dismantle .

clean.tx: Ò lò vòu fòrza schòn è survagnú in téc quajda d' í par crapa, tgu a vju difarènts lògans tg’ i vèvan sitau gjù ad èra … vagnú ò cristalaṣ ètcè̱tara, tga quaj è fòrza schòn stau in téc al … mòtif tgu a antschiat dad í par crapa.
clean.tl: Out there I might have started enjoying looking for stones a bit, when I saw different places where they had blasted , and crystals and so forth … had come out, so maybe this has been a bit the reason why I began to go for stones.

clean.tx: Schabi tga lu, cun siṣ òns capév’ ins hald aun mèmja pauc a vèva bigja la … fòrsa da fá zatgéj.
clean.tl: Although then, at the age of six, one would understand too little and wouldn’t have the … strength to do something.

clean.tx: Gè, ah … cèrtas tgaussas al tat, lèz al dé òra mava lu bjè par lèna a mava lu vidòra in tòc a pinava ògna, a vagnéva vidajn … tg’ èl mava a rimnava, gljèz èra aun léjgar cu ’l scarpava gjù urticlas.
clean.tl: Yes, ah, certain things my grandfather, he would often look for wood the whole day, and he would then go down a little bit and log alder, and when he was coming up … when he would go and collect it, that was really funny when he pulled off nettles.

clean.tx: Quaj duvrava `l par dá dis pòrs, trúfals ansjaman par dá áls pòrs.
clean.tl: This he used to give the pigs, potatoes together to give the pigs.

clean.tx: Ju tartgava quaj è bitga pussajval.
clean.tl: I thought that this was not possible.

clean.tx: Ad è zatgéj … léjgar èr’ èra cu 'l fagèva fjuc.
clean.tl: And something … funny was also when he made fire.

clean.tx: Èl vèv’ adina … lèna vèva `l dètg avùnda, ábar ajn gé̱néral vagnévi bitga fatg òra.
clean.tl: He had always … wood, he had enough, but it was generally not split.

clean.tx: Quaj èra magari da quèls pléjdars dad in mèter dus, ùs ussusché.
clean.tl: These were sometimes such blocks of one or two metres or so.

clean.tx: Quaj catschava `l ajn, qu’ èr’ in plantschju da … da taratsch naturálmajn.
clean.tl: This he would throw into , this was a floor of … of soil, of course.

clean.tx: Quaj catschava `l vidajn ála fuajna api mù catschava sjantar mintg’ jèda.
clean.tl: That is what he used to throw into the fireplace and he used to throw in more every time.

clean.tx: Álṣò i èra schòn in in spazjal.
clean.tl: Well, he really was a special person.

clean.tx: A… in’ autra tgaussa … tg' è è stau intarassanta, èra, quaj èra … ajgl unviarn api vèvani ah … mávani culs tiars ajnta Nacla, quaj è … dadajns … Surajn, fòrza végn minutas vidajn.
clean.tl: And … another thing … that was interesting was, this was during winter and they had ah … they used to go with the animals up to Nacla, this is … farther behind … Surrein, maybe twenty minutes farther behind.

clean.tx: Ad ju sa la tata vèva détg:
clean.tl: And I know my grandmother had said:

clean.tx: «Té nò lu vidòr ùssa. Lò, quèsta sèra dòrma lu bigja ajn lò.»
clean.tl: Come down here now.

clean.tx: Al bjè durméva `l ajn lò, álṣò durmju ajn nuégl.
clean.tl: He slept mostly up there, well, slept in the barn.

clean.tx: Sch’ èri vagnú gjù la lavina, vèva príu ṣuròra dal, dal clavau, vèva príu ṣuròra tùt, èra mù al … ál … nuégl ṣùtajn.
clean.tl: So the avalanche came down, swept away above of the, of the barn, had swept away everything from above, only … the, in the barn underneath.

clean.tx: A par part vèvi aun príu dals nuégls, vévi príu, davauntíar è príu navèn.
clean.tl: And had also partially swept away of the barns, had swept away, also swept away at the front.

clean.tx: Duaṣ vacas èran gjùṣùt aun adina … pandí a la cadajna cul’ … cul’ ajssa nùca la cadajn' èra, al tat udju ṣchùbar nuét.
clean.tl: Two cows were still … hanging from the chain with the … with the plank where the chain was, and my grandfather hadn’t heard anything at all.

clean.tx: A … gè quaj è ussusché in pèr da quèlas raminiscènzas tgu a gju cul tat.
clean.tl: And … yes, so these are some of the memories I have had with my grandfather.

clean.tx: Ju a maj gju pròblè̱m – èl vès maj savilau cun mè né anzatgéj, ju a adina gju fétg ugèn al tat.
clean.tl: I have never had a problem – he would never have got angry at me or something like that, I have always been very fond of my grandfather.

clean.tx: A quaj tga `l vèva pia sias flajvlèzas, quaj sùnd ju vagnús séssúra pér … plé tart.
clean.tl: And that he had … his weaknesses, this I only discovered … later.

clean.tx: A lu ṣaj … èl è lu saravagnús dètg stupèn, èl ò lu luvrau anzjaman.
clean.tl: And then, he recovered perfectly well, he then worked together .

clean.tx: In auc … èra lu staus cun èl a fatg al pur.
clean.tl: Then one of my uncles … stayed with him and worked as a farmer.

clean.tx: A lèz fijèva al al pur, aun adin’ in pin purèssar, lèz mava lu aun a, ad uáut, piná lèna.
clean.tl: And he worked as a farmer, still a little farm, he would then also go to, to the forest fell timber.

clean.tx: A … vagnéva mè̱ndar a mè̱ndar a dumagnavan bigj' èl ál, ál spital lèva `l bitg í né tiar miadis.
clean.tl: And … it became worse and worse and they couldn’t induce to go to the, to the hospital he didn’t want to go, nor to the doctors.

clean.tx: Ad ju sa in' jèda òn Cadruvi, sa ju in' jèda tg’ èl èra vagnús sé, quèl vasèva schòn ò ṣgarṣchajval.
clean.tl: And I know once in the Cadruvi square that he had once come up , he looked terrible.

clean.tx: Èl mava misarábal. A la mùma è lura, plaunsjú ṣèni vagní da fá í scha vèva `l rùt in calum.
clean.tl: He was not going well.

clean.tx: Api jus trajs jamnas cun quaj … calum antù̱rn, a lu ò `l stju í ál spital.
clean.tl: And he walked around with this … thigh for three weeks, and then he had to go to the hospital.

clean.tx: Quèl’ è la sulèt’ jèda tg’ èl è pròpi stauṣ ál spital.
clean.tl: This is the only time he had really been to hospital.

clean.tx: Api òni tractau quaj, a sjantar mava quaj bigja plé gjù Surajn parquaj tga la tat’ èra è gè ina véglja, a lu ṣ’ èl vivjus sé tiar nus sén Tgès’ Alva, nus stèvan cò, viajn … Tgès’ Alva, quèla tgèsa grònda òragjùṣùt al muséum.
clean.tl: And they treated that, and after this it was not possible any more for him to live in Surrein because my grandmother already was an old woman after all, and then he lived with us in the white house, we lived here, in … the white house, that is the big house underneath the museum.

clean.tx: Lu ṣ' èl vivjús tiar nus. Ábar ah … quaj vèva lu dau ina … ina … tussègazjun dal saun, sjantar lu ṣ’ èl maj vagnús pròpi nònavaun.
clean.tl: And then he lived with us.

clean.tx: A lu vajn nuṣ aun sju gudaj al tat, fòrza tgéj, dus trajs majnṣ a gju bjè léjgar cun èl.
clean.tl: And then we were able to enjoy my grandfather a bit longer, maybe - how long?

clean.tx: Èl durméva bjè, quaj mava `l sél baunpégna, api mavi èl, tatlava `l ugèn música, ah, quaj savèva `l, durmí a tatlá música ajn ina.
clean.tl: He slept a lot and used to go on the oven bench and he would go, he loved to listen to the music, ah, this he was able to do, sleep and listen to the music at the same time.

clean.tx: A dumandavan nus lu èra, magari inqual discuérṣ vajn nus schòn gju a raṣdava bigja bjè, ábar ah … scha `l vèva bian, vagnév’ ins schòn séssúra inqual tgaussas.
clean.tl: And if we asked him , we really had a conversation with him from time to time, and he didn’t speak much, but eh … when he was in a good mood, one could get to know some things.

clean.tx: A lu ṣè `l lu...ra gè ana … sissòntasját ṣè 'l mòrts.
clean.tl: And then he is then still, yes 1967 he died.

clean.tx: A Cazis da las sòras adina hahhhh RS, da da MaitliRS, diani, né ṣchèvani lura da da Cazis.
clean.tl: The nuns’s in Cazas always , hah, the ‘recruit school’, ‘the girl’s recruit school’, right?, they used to call Cazas.

clean.tx: Ahm, a quaj èra schòn ah, a vagnéva fétg strèng, álṣò quaj nus vagnévan pròpi tanidas a nus stuèvan amprèndar a nus stuèvan ṣchubargè a fá a tùt.
clean.tl: Ahm, and that was in fact ah, and it was getting very strict, well, and we were really kept and we had to study and we had to clean and do and everything.

clean.tx: A zacuras èri ahm … da fá pènṣums, lu èri ruaus, in’ ura da fá pènṣums, a sjantar, a scalinavi a lu vèvans dad ira … a fá òrazjún la sèra, quaj èra tùts tga vèvan da dad í sé sissúm, fá òrazjún da da la sèra.
clean.tl: And sometime or another we had eh … to do our homework, then it was quiet, one hour to do our homework and after , and the bell rang and we had to go … to pray in the evening, then all had to to go upstairs, to the very top, to say the evening prayers.

clean.tx: Api sjantar vèvan nus líbar atgnamajn uschéja mjaṣ’ ura, trajs quardṣ d’ ura tga nuṣ astgèvan fá, álṣò èssar plé dad aut, a lura … da da las déjṣch èri craj né mjasa las déjṣch èri ruaus, pals gancs antù̱rn, ad ajn tgòmbras da las déjsch stizá cazùla.
clean.tl: And then we were free for about more or less half an hour, three quarters of an hour that we were allowed to do, well, to be louder, and then … at at ten o’clock it had to be, I believe, or half past nine it had to be quiet, in the corridors, and in the bedroom the light was turned off at ten.

clean.tx: Api tgi ca fagèva bigja quaj, a vagnéva traplada, las sòras mavan mù schi a guardja, tgi ca vagnéva traplaus stuèva al vèndardís sèra … stá lò, stgèvan bigj’ í a tgèsa, api stèvan nuṣ ṣchùbargè in’ ura zatgéj, durmí lò, api stèvan lu í pér la sònda andamaun a tgèsa.
clean.tl: And the person who … didn’t do that and who got caught, the nuns would just walk around on guard duty, the person who got caught had to … remain there on Friday evening, they were not allowed to go home, and then they had to clean for more or less one hour, sleep there, and then could only go home on Saturday morning.

clean.tx: Qu’ èra … quèlas règlas.
clean.tl: These were … those rules.

clean.tx: A las sòras savèvan tga nus trajs nuṣ vagjan adina uléjgar, a nus mò̱ndian bugèn cò gjù a scùla, a nus fé̱tschian filistùcas, ad èlas pudévan maj tiar nus.
clean.tl: And the nuns knew that the three of us, we always had fun, and that we liked to come to school down here, and that we used to play pranks, and that they would never be able to prove anything against us.

clean.tx: A lu èri … da quèlaṣ uras, ah da quaj tjamṣ aun tga … ahm, als amprandissadiṣ antschavévan par part igl avrél.
clean.tl: And then there was … at that time, ah at that time still that … ahm, the apprenticeships would partly begin in April.

clean.tx: A lu, ah, álṣò ajn nòssa classa, c' ju mava ála tjarza sacundara, igl avrél antschavévaṣ amprém da vagní òd scùla, al davús èranṣ aun quátar … buébas tga mavan a scùla ála tjarza sacundara.
clean.tl: And then, ah, in our class, when I attended the third grade of secondary school, in April you would first come out of school, at the end we were only four … girls that attended the third grade of secondary school.

clean.tx: A lu ajn ajn tgòmbra eri ina tga vèva survgnú igl avrél plaza.
clean.tl: And then in our room there was one that had got a job in April.

clean.tx: A las sòras savèvan, quèl’ ò ùṣ aun in’ jamna, a quèlaṣ òn bigja pudju tiar nus da fá stá in vèndardís.
clean.tl: And the nuns knew this one had only one week , and they haven’t been able to make us stay one Friday.

clean.tx: Api èra la sòra òra uschéja … avaun niaṣ ésch ad ò spatgau a spatgau tòca la audi anzatgéj, api ṣè … ina da nòssa tgòmbra id’ òn tualèta api fò la sòra:
clean.tl: And then the nun was out like this … in front of our door, waiting and waiting until she would hear something, and then … one of our room went out to the toilet, and the nun said:

clean.tx: «Chasch denn grad usrichta, Fritig obig müänd är do bliiba.»
clean.tl: You can just tell that you have to stay here on Friday evening.

clean.tx: Api ò èla cò détg: «Cool, ju mòn grad a raquénta dad èlas.»
clean.tl: And then she said there: «Cool, I’ll just go and tell them.»

clean.tx: Èla vagnid’ ajn tgòmbra api fò la: «Scheisse! Nus stuajn stá cò vèndardís»
clean.tl: She came into the bedroom and said: «Shit!

clean.tx: A quaj vid risadas.

clean.tx: A lu vajn nus ah durmju lò, api l’ autar dé èssan nus … i a a … cù è l' nùm, ju a cùls nùmṣ in téc misérjaṣ, a Gletsch.
clean.tl: And then we ah slept there, and the next day we went to, to … what is the name, these names I have some problems, to Gletsch.

clean.tx: A lu vajn nuṣ durmju lò, api navèn da Gletsch èssan nus, lò vajn nus lu stu í sén via `ssan nuṣ i sé sél Grimsel, a lu vajn nuṣ durmju sé ál hòspi̱z sé dal Grimsel, a lu èssan nus … i … ah, cùls méls.
clean.tl: And then we slept there, and from Gletsch we – there we then had to go on the way, we went up to the Grimsel and then we slept up there at the guesthouse on the Grimsel, and then we … went on … eh with the mules.

clean.tx: Lò dati ina, sé dal Grimsel vagnévi ina … in … in trùtg da sauma nùca tga mavan cùls cùls méls né cùls tgavals.
clean.tl: There there is a, from the Grimsel there came a … a … a bridle path where one would go with the mules or horses.

clean.tx: A lura ah … mju quinau manava in mél, – lu vèva `l dus – ad ju manava in.
clean.tl: And then eh … my brother-in-law led one mule – at that time he had two – and I led one.

clean.tx: A lu ò `l détg èl sapi bigja vagní da luòra, ju, èl stètgi mal, èl mòndi da via òra, a lu va ju rantau in mél vi dal autar, álṣò vi da la … vi dal … cavèstar da lèz, álṣò vi dal … dal bast da lèz scù inṣ di, api ah sùnd jus cùn dòmaṣdús.
clean.tl: And then he said he couldn’t walk on that path, that I - that he was sorry, that he would walk on the road, and then I bound one mule to the other, well, to the … eh to the bridle of this one, that is to say to the the packsaddle of that one as one says, and then eh I left with both .

clean.tx: A qu' èra schòn strètg, álṣò sch’ ju stèṣ aun fá in’ jèda quaj, figès ju bétga.
clean.tl: And this was really narrow, well, if I had to do it once again, I wouldn’t do it.

clean.tx: Mintgataun vasèvaṣ gjùadò grad agradgjù, tòcan gjù èl’ aua, álṣò sch’ in fùṣ ùssa tagljau, quèlas … al bùrdi stèva ò ualti gljunsch, quaj balantschava in téc.
clean.tl: From time to time one looked directly down, directly down, until down in the water, well, if one of these had been cut, these… the load was sticking out quite a lot, it was rolling a bit.

clean.tx: A lur scha `l vèṣ ùssa pagljau par èxè̱mpal in grép tga vès pudju bétar èl, scha quèls fùssan grat schulaj gjù ajl’ aua, ajl lac.
clean.tl: And then if it hit a rock which could have thrown it down, the mules would have immediately fallen down rapidly into the water, into the lake.

clean.tx: Ábar è ju … ju raṣdav' in téc cùn èls, ju èra mèz èr … saspruava dad èssar ruassajvals, quaj è ju tiptòp, tòcan ò atrás.
clean.tl: But I also, I spoke a bit with them, I was myself also … tried hard to remain calm, this went perfectly throughout the whole trip.

clean.tx: A lu èssans lu i l’ autar dé.
clean.tl: And the next day we went there.

clean.tx: La davùsa nògj vajn nuṣ durmju … a Guottannen.
clean.tl: The last night we slept in Guttannen.

clean.tx: Quaj èra, dad ira cùn cùn sauma èra quaj súpar cùn quèls, cùn quèls méls.
clean.tl: This was, to go with bridles, this was great with these, with these mules.

clean.tx: Què è pròpa tiars plé déstinaj par ah fá … sauma.
clean.tl: These were really animals that are more suited to being bridled.

clean.tx: A lura … va ju lu èra ábar … méz èls a sùt.
clean.tl: And then … but … I also yoked them.

clean.tx: A … ajl, lò, èran è lu bétga schi … schi flòts dad í cùn cùn cròtscha né cùn tgar.
clean.tl: And … in the, it was not so … so nice to walk them with a plough or a cart.

clean.tx: A lò … vajn nuṣ gju savèns dificultats, gè.
clean.tl: And there … we often had troubles, yes.

clean.tx: Bjè jèdaṣ ṣèni scapaj tga nuṣ vajn ah pròpi gju ah gròndas misé̱rjas a mju quinau … ṣchèva, ṣchèva savèns:
clean.tl: They escaped many times so that we had big troubles and my brother-in-law … often said, said:

clean.tx: «Ah, cò èssan nus mitschaj cùla véta, cò vèssans sju èssar mòrts.»
clean.tl: «Here we escaped with our lives, here we could have been dead.»

clean.tx: In’ jèda èssan nus staj … sén Tschamùt.
clean.tl: Once we were in Tschamùt.

clean.tx: Nuṣ vèvan, ju vèva cumprau, midau òr in, in … vèv’ ju vandju a cumprau in autar parquaj tgu vèva l’ imprèssjun tga, tg’ èra quèl tga fagèva bitg andrètg, a lu èssan nus, vajn nus méz sùt èls, dòmaṣdús, al quinau èra ad ju anzjaman api èssan nuṣ i sén Tschamùt, a sé spèr l’ ustria da Tschamùt … vajn nus ah … èssan nus samanaj, gjù sél parcadi èssan nus samanaj.
clean.tl: We had, I had bought, exchanged one, one … I had sold and bought another because I had the impression that, that it was this one that didn’t behave properly, and then we, we yoked them, both, I together with my brother-in-law were together and then we went up to Tschamut, and there next to the restaurant of Tschamut … we eh … we turned back, down on the parking space we turned back.

clean.tx: A schi … schi glajti scù nuṣ èssan staj sén la via cantunala, òni antschiat a galòpá.
clean.tl: And as … as soon as we were on the cantonal way they started to gallop.

clean.tx: A lu vès ju bitga ugagjau plé, da, dad ira cùn èls vinanavaun.
clean.tl: And then I wouldn’t have dared to, to, to go farther with them any more.

clean.tx: Lu vain nus rantau èls lò, api sùnd jus gjù pal tgar anèx, api èssan nus … sùnd jus sé … cùl tgar anèx.
clean.tl: We then tied them there, and then I went down for the trailer and then we … I went up … with the trailer.

clean.tx: Tùt saniastar, a galòpavan zatgéj starmantúṣ, ju stèva séla brèmṣa.
clean.tl: On the very left, and they galloped terribly, I stood on the brake.

clean.tx: Al quinau èr’ in ùm, pròp’ in ùm fèrm.
clean.tl: My brother-in-law was a man, a really strong man.

clean.tx: A lu èra … sé Tschamùt, cu i òn antschiat a galòpá, èri grat stau avaun mèssa …, ina mèssa da sjantarmjaṣ èn caplùta da Sòntga Clau.
clean.tl: And then there was … in Tschamut, when they began to gallop, there had just been a mass … an afternoon mass in the chapel of St.

clean.tx: A lu, agl aucségnar, par clétg èra la gljut schòn vidòragjù̱ – quèls tg’ èran staj a mèssa èran schòn vidòragjù̱ – pléndanòragjù̱ tga quaj tga nuṣ èssan, tg’ als, tg’ als méls èn galòpaj.
clean.tl: And then the priest, fortunately the people were already down – those who had attended the mass were already down – farther down than we were, that the, that the mules galloped.

clean.tx: Quèls èn staj ò dal prígal.
clean.tl: These were out of danger.

clean.tx: Ábar gl aucségnar èra in aucségnar tudèstg.
clean.tl: But the priest was a German priest.

clean.tx: A lèz èr’ avaun caplùta cu, cu nuṣ èssan vagní, a lu ò `l, ò `l détg – èl è lu vagnús cùgl autò … anòragjù cu nuṣ vèvan … rantau als, als méls – a lu, a … lu vajn nuṣ, va ju dumandau sch’ èl prandéssi mè tòcan … a Ruèras.
clean.tl: And he was in front of the chapel when, when we came, and then he, he said – he then came with the car … down when we had … tied the, the mules – and then, and … then we, I asked whether he could take me down to Rueras.

clean.tx: Naturálmajn, èl agi vju tgéj … déṣgrázja né tgé, tgé nuṣ ágian gju, tgé événimajn … nuṣ vajn gju cùls méls.
clean.tl: Of course, he had seen what … accident or what what we had had, what event … we had had with the mules.

clean.tx: Ábar èl vagi lura pandarau a tartgau na:
clean.tl: But he had then thought about it and thought no:

clean.tx: Nua Jésus végn gassaljaus, né?
clean.tl: Where Jesus is being flagellated, right?

clean.tx: A lu ṣchajnṣ adina al … sòntgè̱t òdém al vitg.
clean.tl: And then we always say the … little chapel at the lowest part of the village.

clean.tx: Álṣò ùṣ è `l bigja plé òdém al vitg, ábar quaj sòntgè̱t èra, in’ jèda, òdém al vitg, a quaj, quaj è atgnamajn rastau, né.
clean.tl: Well, now it is not at the lowest part of the village any more, but this chapel was once at the lowest part of the village, and this, this is still so, right?

clean.tx: Sch’ té vaṣ dl vitg òra, scha … ṣaj `l … drètg, vagní gè bagagjau da néiv hòtè̱l Albṣú, né, a lu … vas fòrsa aun végn mè̱tars, a lu ṣè `l saniastar.
clean.tl: If you walk down the valley, … the hotel Alpsu has in fact been renovated on the right side, right?, and then you walk maybe twenty more metres, and then it is on the left.

clean.tx: Qu’ è adin' aviart a lu saṣ í ajn api vèzas té quèlas ah … figuras … ajn gròndèzja da carstgaun.
clean.tl: This is always open, and then you can step in and then you see these eh … figures … the size of human beings.

clean.tx: A qu’ è in ah, in Andreoli da, da Mustajr tg’ èra usché in téc ah, gè, vèva talènt, vèva tagljau ò quèlas.
clean.tl: And this is a eh, a, Andreoli from Mustér who was a little eh, yes, had talent, had chiselled these out.

clean.tx: Da tgei temps?
clean.tl: At what time?

clean.tx: Ah, méli ad òtg … tgu craj ṣè stau Vèndardís Sògn mili ad òtg tschian trènta quátar, fòrsa scha ju ṣbaglja bitg, ṣè quèlas figuras lu vagnidas trans a mézaṣ ajn quèla, ajn quaj sòntgè̱t.
clean.tl: Ah, eighteen hundred … it was on Good Friday 1834, maybe, if I am not wrong, yes, when these figures were transported and put into this little chapel.

clean.tx: Ad ál’ antschata èra `l sòntgè̱t … in sòntgè̱t aviart, quaj vut dí quaj è in pin baghètg, a cò èr’ in gártar, a lu vasèvas té ajn quèlas.
clean.tl: And at the beginning the little chapel … was an open chapel, which means that it is a small building, and there there was a grating, and then you see these therein.

clean.tx: A lu òni aun bagagjau vitlúndar ina, aun ina part, lu ṣèn … in pèr bauns pins, gè, intarassant, gè, a méz in clutgè ánò véntgò̱tg tégn ju, gè.
clean.tl: And then, in addition, they built another part next to the chapel, then there are … some small benches, yes, interesting, yes, and also built a clock tower in 28 I think, yes.

clean.tx: Quaj vò anavù̱s sén ina tradizjun tga … Tuatschíns èran ira … a pèlègrinádi a Nossa a lu vas lò zanúa, vas té ṣur in, ah, ṣur in pas, álṣò in, in crèst, in sémpal pas, a sén quèla, sén quaj pas duèssi èssar ina samagljònta caplùta, è cun ina stazjun da … da la via da la crusch, a lu … ṣè quèls vagní anavù̱s ajn Tujétsch a détg:
clean.tl: This goes back to a tradition that … some inhabitants of Tujetsch had gone … on a pilgrimage to Einsiedeln, and then you go there somewhere, you go over a, eh, over a pass, rather a high ground, a simple pass, and on this, on this pass there should be a similar chapel, also with a station of … of Christ’s way to the Cross, and then they came back to Tujetsch and said:

clean.tx: «Usché zatgé fagjajn nuṣ è a Sadrún.»
clean.tl: We’ll also make something like this in Sedrun.

clean.tx: A quaj è tùt schabagjau sén basa privata, álṣò quèla caplùta è stada tòcan avaun fòrsa déjṣch òns privat.
clean.tl: And this all happened on a private basis, this chapel has thus been private until maybe ten years ago.

clean.tx: Ad ùṣ ò la plajv surpríu aj.
clean.tl: And now the parish has taken it over.

clean.tx: A lu vèvani dépònju quèlas, quèlas státuas vèvani dépònju ajn tgèsa
clean.tl: And then they stored these, these statues they had stored in the presbytery.

clean.tx: Quèla stèva dadò `l hòtè̱l Cruna.
clean.tl: It was located after the Hotel Cruna, down the valley.

clean.tx: Quaj hanlégj da tiars, ál sén scù quaj tg' i èra ál ṣchènivával tschantanè, tg' als martgadònts cumpravan als tiars quasi schòn la pr̩mavèra, alura mavan quèls stjarls, als mùtgs, als stjarls mavan lu ád alp, a lura sjantar alp, agl atù̱n, vagnévani lu par èls a mavan cun èls lura ṣur Lucmagn a vandévan lò.
clean.tl: This cattle business, in the sense of how it was in the nineteenth century, that the merchants would buy the animals already during spring, then those one-year-old calves, the two-year-old calves, the one-year-old calves would go to the mountain pastures, and after that period, during autumn, they would go and fetch them and would then go with them over the Lucmagn pass and would sell them there.

clean.tx: Quaj mava lu radù̱n, quaj mava ò da Tujétsch, mavi radù̱n duatschían, fòrsa antù̱rn duatschían tgaus.
clean.tl: There would go about, there would go then out of the Tujetsch valley, there would go about two hundred, maybe about two hundred heads .

clean.tx: A qu’ è atgnamajn al … sulèt danè … quasi tg’ al pur vèva blùt danè, né.
clean.tl: And this is at least almost the … only cash money … the farmers had, right?

clean.tx: A lu mávani magari culs tiars gjù a Ligjaun, a … savèvan bigja vèndar lò, a lu stèvani quasi í gjùdòra, ir tòc’ al nòrd da l’ Italja gjùdajn ad ampruá da vèndar, ah … ad aj ah … vagnéva bigj’ éba vandju tùt, al davùs stuèvani vèndar fòrsa pr̩, pr̩ in schliat prézi, né.
clean.tl: And then they would go sometimes down to Lugano and … could not sell there, and then they had so to speak to go outside , to go until the North of Italy and try to sell, eh … and then they could not sell all after all, and in the end they would have to sell maybe for, for a bad price, right?

clean.tx: Cu nuṣ èran buébas, èri bja autar tgé ùssa.
clean.tl: When we were girls, it was very different from nowadays.

clean.tx: Als gjanitu̱rs fagèvan al pur, ad ju èra tschavrèr’ in tjams, ajn l’ antschata cun mju frá, in òn parsula, api stavèv’ ins í culas tgauras tòca sé Nalps, a vèvan in bi tjams lò, vagnéva … lu èri aun bigja turists, mintgataun vagnévi in in in car, a quèls vèvan naturálmajn plaṣchaj da nus a dlas tgauras.
clean.tl: My parents were farmers, and I was a goatherd for a certain time, at the beginning with my brother, one year alone, and one had to go with the goats as far as Nalps, and we had a great time there, there came … then there weren’t tourists yet, from time to time a a a bus arrived, and it was, of course, a pleasure for them to be with us and the goats.

clean.tx: A cu ins vagnéva anavù̱s èri bigja schi flòt pr̩, cu inṣ vagnéva cò cu `ls purs vagnévan a savilavan cun nus, ni tumévan par nus, api stèvan nuṣ vagní a tgèsa ad a … múlgjar tùt las tgauras.
clean.tl: And when we came back, it wouldn’t be that nice for us, when one came here, when the farmers would come and get angry at us, or were worried because of us, and then we had to go home and milk all the goats.

clean.tx: Als gjanitu̱rṣ vèvan aun pòrs, stèvan fá gljèz, a quaj è naturálmajn ùssa samidau bjè.
clean.tl: My parents, in addition, had pigs, and we had to look after them, and nowadays this has of course changed a lot.

clean.tx: Navèn da lu tòcan, ad è stau ábar in bi tjams. Ad oz lajni gnanc í la buébanáglja, nus mavan cun tschun òns èran nus tgavrèrs, ad ozaldé, gè.
clean.tl: From then up to, but it was a nice time.

clean.tx: Aber la notg buc, la notg…
clean.tl: But at night not, at night …

clean.tx: Qu’ è stau in bi tjams.
clean.tl: This was a wonderful time.

clean.tx: Ju savès raquintá, ju sùn stauṣ al davùs purtgè … da Sadrún, cun aun in in in camarat.
clean.tl: I could tell, I was the last swineherd … of Sedrun, together with a mate.

clean.tx: Sùnd ju sapladjus cun in ah coléga … è da Sadrún, a … lèz èra schòn jus l’ ampréma classa.
clean.tl: I got employed with a eh mate … also from Sedrun, and … he had already attended the first term .

clean.tx: A nuṣ duṣ vajn supríu da fá purtgè da Sadrún, a Gjònda.
clean.tl: And the two of us took over of working as the swineherd of Sedrun, at Gionda .

clean.tx: Quaj vùl dí qu’ èra lu al tgauvitg, quèl vèva pladjú nus.
clean.tl: This means, this was the head of the village who had employed us.

clean.tx: Ju sa bitg tgé piaglja nuṣ vajn gju, álṣò nuṣ vajn gju ina pintga piáglja, parquaj, gljèz raquint' ju al davùs.
clean.tl: I don’t know what salary we got, well, we got a small salary; therefore, this I’ll tell at the end.

clean.tx: Quaj vul dí, nuṣ vèvan èxáct végn pòrs, quaj sa ju … tschian pròcè̱nt.
clean.tl: This means, we had exactly twenty pigs, this I know one hundred percent.

clean.tx: A nuṣ duṣ vèvan dad í a rimná quèls pòrs, prèndar òr, schá ò èlṣ ò da nuégl.
clean.tl: And the two of us had to go and collect these pigs, take out, let them out, out of the barn.

clean.tx: Duṣ èran vin Gjònda craju, lu catschav' ju quèls vi Sadrún, ad in pèr èran vi Sadrún, nus stèvan sèzs … catschá als pòrs ò da nuégl, a lu rimná èls, a qu’ èra fòrsa vi da las … òtg né uschéja, né mjása las nùf.
clean.tl: Two were over there in Gionda I believe, then I droved those to Sedrun, and some were in Sedrun, we had … to drove the pigs out of the barn ourselves, and then collect them, and that was maybe around … eight or so, or half past eight.

clean.tx: Má tga … avaun nus èra sagir al tgavrè èra schòn jus culas tgauras, lèz mava lu èra.
clean.tl: Since … before us the goatherd had certainly already gone with the goats, he also used to go.

clean.tx: A … viars anòr’sé da Val Strém ajn.
clean.tl: And upwards into the Strem Valley.

clean.tx: A nus rimnau quèls végn pòrs, a vèvan nuṣ da catschá èls in dètg tòc, da Sadrún sédòra, da la pastira sé tòcan sé Valtgèva.
clean.tl: And we collected those twenty pigs, and we had to drove them quite a long way, from Sedrun up, from the pasture up to Valtgeva.

clean.tx: Ùssa … pòrs …, tgi ca sò quaj, lèzs èn ualti stinaj da, da catschá èls, da da dad í cun èls, quaj è bigj’ in animal scù ina tgaura né ina vaca, quèls èn bégja andisaj, èlṣ èn ajn nuégl, ad ùs tùtajnína stùni antschajvar ad í.
clean.tl: Now … pigs …, those who know that, they are quite obstinate when one droves them, when one goes with them, this is not an animal like a goat or a cow, they are not used to it, they are in the pigsty, and now suddenly they must start going.

clean.tx: Ajn tùta cas mia, mia mùma a la mùma da mju còlè̱ga tg’ èra è cun mè … vèvan stju gidá nus in pèr dis … da catschè èls a rimná quèls pòrs, a catschè èls sédòra.
clean.tl: Anyhow my, my mother and the mother of my mate who was with me … had had to help us for a couple of days … to drove them and gather these pigs, and drove them up.

clean.tx: A sé Valtgèva cu nuṣ èran tras … èri lò ina pòrt’, ina gjajna, a cu nuṣ vajn aviart la gjajna, savèvan nus sèrá la gjajna dals pòrs, stèvans sé cò ajn quaj plat, a nuṣ vèvan da fá ajnsassèz … nagina lavur, nuṣ vèvan ina bjala véta.
clean.tl: And up in Valtgeva, when we were through … there was a door there, a gate, and when we opened the gate, we could close the pig’s gate, we could stay up there on this flat ground, and actually … we had nothing to do, we had a wonderful life.

clean.tx: A lu la sèra … stèvan nus rimná als pòrs, a lu vagnévan gjù cù̱ntar la gjajna, a nuṣ vèvan da dumbrá.
clean.tl: And then in the evening we had to gather the pigs, and then we came down to the gate and had to count .

clean.tx: Ad ju sa, ju èra bégj’ aun jus l’ ampréma classa, ju vèva problèms da dumbrá quèls végn pòrs dad in tòcan végn.
clean.tl: And I know, I hadn’t attended the first class yet, I had difficulties counting these pigs from one to twenty.

clean.tx: Álṣò … ju vèva braja da dumbrá in tòcan végn, mirá tga nuṣ vajn tùt als pòrs.
clean.tl: Well … I had troubles in counting one to twenty, in ensuring that we had all the pigs.

clean.tx: A lu catschavan nuṣ als pòrs gjù Sadrún, a schavan èls ajn nuégl, l’ autar dé puspè ajnsé.
clean.tl: And then we would drove the pigs down to Sedrun, and would leave them in the pigsty, the next day again up .

clean.tx: Qu’ è stau, ju sùn è staus lùschs da mi’ ampréma plaza, parquaj tga … al davùṣ dé, cu ju a dascargjau als pòrs, scha ṣè al bap da mju còlè̱ga vagnús cun – èl vèva in unimòc – vagnús cun nus sé Valtgèva, a las mùmas vèvan praparau tiar mats … pals pòrs, a vèvan … usché cun … mats, fatg antù̱rn in sujèt mataj a méz sé quaj antù̱rn al vjantar dals pòrs.
clean.tl: This was, I was also proud of my first job, because … the last day, when I drove the pigs down, my mate’s father came with – he had a unimog – came with us to Valtgèva, and the mothers had prepared bunches of flowers … for the pigs, and had … so with … bunches of flowers, tied a rope around, and put them around the belly of the pigs.

clean.tx: A nuṣ vagní gjù da Valtgèva fòrsa cun tschun sis pòrs, cun sé matg.
clean.tl: And we would come down from Valtgeva with maybe five or six pigs, with their bunches of flowers.

clean.tx: Da mintga pur stèvanṣ í a scha `l vèva gju dus, stèva `l pijè … dus pòrs né in né uschéa … ábar ju sa bigja còns raps nuṣ vèvan … gju d’ incassá, mataj dus … fòrsa tschun francs par piartg.
clean.tl: We had to go to every farmer and if he had given two, he should more … two pigs or one or so … but I don’t know how much money we … had to collect, probably two … maybe five francs for each pig.

clean.tx: A tiar in pur … èn nuṣ í, èr’ ju, vèv’ ju gju dad incassá quèls raps, a quèl vèva bégja grad munajda ad usché vinavaun, a quèl ò quaj mumèn bgja dau, ad ju a lu amblidau quaj, ábar mia mùma ò aun detg, aun ònṣ ad òns sjantar:

clean.tl: Well, arrived home, we wouldn't stay long.

clean.tx: A savèva lu è èssar tgé aura tg’ i èra.
clean.tl: And it also depended on what kind of weather there was.

clean.tx: Má tg’ al bjè a tgèsa vèv’ ins lungurús, a sch’ ins vèva lungurús, mav’ ins òdaviart a figèva zatgéj.
clean.tl: Since in most cases it was boring at home, and if one was bored, one would go outside and do something.

clean.tx: Nus mavan bjè, gè, a fá gjucs, scù tg’ ins fagèva plé baut … fòrsa da quaj da pòlici’ a ládar … da quaj.
clean.tl: We would often go and play, as one would do it in the past … maybe games of police and thief … things like that.

clean.tx: Ad ju sa mè̱tar avaun òzaldé̱ … sa ju bigja métar avaun plé tg’ i fòn da gljèz, né?
clean.tl: And I can imagine nowadays … I cannot imagine any more that they play that, right?

clean.tx: Nus mavan par èxè̱mpal è … gljèz è hald è clar … ùṣ ṣaj vagnú in téc plé spès, tùt cun tgèsas ….
clean.tl: We would also go, for instance … this is also clear … now it has become a bit more dense, all with houses … .

clean.tx: Nuṣ vèvan halt … aun aviart in téc daplé … curtín, détsch ju, ùṣa … drètg a saniastar, tg’ ins savèv’ aun fá lò in téc balapaj … drègj a saniastar.
clean.tl: We had in fact … still a few more open … garden, I say, now … right and left, so that we still could play a bit of football … right and left.

clean.tx: A né grad è gl unviarn cunzún mavanṣ bjè a bagagjavan sprungṣ a dèvan cun skis né cun ajssa né tg’ ins mava cun bòb da vias gjù … tg’ èra naturálmajn è bigj' aun aschí malsagir ùṣa … scù ùṣa fòrsa dal tráfic a vidanò.
clean.tl: And, right?, especially during winter we often went and built ski jumps and would go skiing or snowboarding, or we would go down the streets on bobsleigh … which was of course not really as unsafe … as now because of the traffic and so on.

clean.tx: Ad i èra difarènza quét’ ju sémplamajn … nus fagèvan plé bjè òdaviart tga quaj tg’ i végn fatg òzaldé̱, quét’ ju.
clean.tl: And there were simply differences I think … we played more often outside than what is done nowadays, I think.

clean.tx: Fòrsa è … clar, nus vèvan schòn è nòs còmpjutars né tgé ca nus vèvan als gameboys a vidanò.
clean.tl: Maybe also … sure, we also had our computers or what did we have?

clean.tx: Ábar … quaj èra schòn bigja schi scù òzaldé … quaj èxtrè̱m.
clean.tl: But this was in fact not like nowadays … so extreme.

clean.tx: Nuṣ vajn gè schi massa … álṣò nus vajn gè sé cò in’ unjun da gjuvantégna.
clean.tl: We have after all so many … well, we have up here a Young People's Association, after all.

clean.tx: Ad ju craj plé baud vèvani schòn aun … nus vèvan schòn in téc plé gròn tschafan da vagní ajn lò … èssar anzjaman cun fòrs’ in téc plé végls a vidanò ….
clean.tl: And I believe that in earlier times they really had … we were really happier to go there … be together with maybe people who were a bit older and so on … .

clean.tx: A quaj òzaldé als gjuvans tga végnan ò da scùla sadatan bigja gjù schi fétg cun in téc plé végls.
clean.tl: And nowadays the young people who come out of school do not want to have to do so much with those who are a bit older.

clean.tx: Ju sùn èba staus … òh, bunamajn déiṣch òns capitani … a lu sa ju schòn in téc sc’ i funczjanava.
clean.tl: As a matter of fact, I was … oh, for almost ten years captain and therefore I know a bit how it used to function.

clean.tx: Nus santupavan, al bjè vèvan nuṣ da fá gjù usché mias’ ur’ avaun sél lòcál, nuṣ vajn in lòcál da gjuvantétgna … nùca tga nus sarimnavan tùts.
clean.tl: We would meet, in most cases we had to meet half an hour or so before, at the place … we have a place where the Young People's Association can meet … where all of us would meet.

clean.tx: A las buébas né las gjufnas mégljardétg, lèzas vèvan lu da … trá ajn ina blus’ alva né trá, gè alf … a tgautschas najras scù’ ls gjuvans èra … mù tga lèzas vèvan da vagní cun in matg flurs, a nuṣ vèvan lu tgi vèva la guís … né … las bandiaras, la fana bial’ a quaj, a lu vèvan nus mintg’ jè in capitani ad in fice.
clean.tl: And the girls or, to be more precise, the young women had to … wear a white blouse or wear, yes, white … and black trousers like the young men too … but the young women had to participate with a bunch of flowers, but some of us had to come with a rifle or with flags, the "beautiful flag" and so, and each time we had a captain and a vice-captain.

clean.tx: L’ antschata c’ ju sùn vagnús ò da scùla … usché avaun quindiṣch òns … lò … anflávani aun plétò̱st da quèls tga fagèvan, ábar ùṣ anflá capitaniṣ è bigja schi sémpal.
clean.tl: At the beginning when I had finished school … about fifteen years ago … there … they would still find people who would do , but nowadays to find captains is not so easy.

clean.tx: Ad ju a al santimajn, laṣ anadas tga végnan ùṣa, astg’ inṣ dí cun buna cuns végnan puspè plé tgunṣch ála gjuvantétgna, i … sadrézan plétò̱st anviars nus.
clean.tl: And I have the feeling, the age groups that are coming now, one can say it with a clear conscience, they come more easily to the Young People's Association, they … rather address us.

clean.tx: Ùṣ ṣai puspè in téc usché … al còc scù … avaun quindiṣch òns, quét’ ju … i è stau ditg lò djantara̱jn, è stau anadas, gè tg’ ins savèva bétga pròpi … nù métar quèls, gè èxáct.
clean.tl: Now it is again a bit like this … the core as … fifteen years ago, I think … it has been a long time in between, there have been age groups, yes, of which one didn't know exactly … where to put them, yes, exactly.

clean.tx: Ábar la difarènza, nùc’ ju vèz’ ina grònda difarènza è scù scòlast da skis dùn ju gè schòn … òtg òns … vèz’ ju bjè tgé ca vò sén pista, grat … dals indigèns anò … i vòn bétga plé schi bjè scù quaj tg’ i mavan in' jèda.
clean.tl: But the difference, where I also see a big difference, as a ski teacher I have already been teaching for eight years … I see a lot of what is going on on the ski slopes, especially … regarding the local people … they don't go as often as they used to go some time ago.

clean.tx: Grad la gjuvantétgna … pauca gjuvantétgna … tgé c’ ins vèza bjè è als plé passaj, als pènṣionaj vèz’ ins bjè sén pista … a tschaj è quèls scù adina halt … quèlas famigljas scù adina.
clean.tl: Especially the youth … little youth … what one often sees are older people, one can see a lot of retired people on the slopes … and the others are those one always sees … these families, as always.

clean.tx: Ábar lò ṣai schòn ju anavù̱ṣ in téc, è cùls indigèns. Ùṣ ani plétò̱st antschiat ajn ad í cuérsa ljunga.
clean.tl: But it has really diminished a bit, also with the local people.

clean.tx: Quaj tg’ i sòn fá datiar … tg’ i sòn fòrsa fá in’ ura api òn i fatg al spòrt dal dé ad òn tutin’ aun zatgé dal dé … uschéa, quèla dirèczjun … éxáct.
clean.tl: That they can do alongside … that they can do maybe for one hour and then they have done their sport for the day and nevertheless still have something of the day … so, something like this … exactly.

clean.tx: Álṣò i òn bunamajn damè̱mja, détsch ju ùṣa frèch.
clean.tl: Well they have almost too much, I would now say naughtily.

clean.tx: Gè, sch’ ju mir’ anavù̱s … quaj è fòrsa sjad, ògj òns … schòn mù gljèz … savèv’ ins í patschíficamajn.
clean.tl: Yes, if I look back … that was maybe seven, eight years … only that … one could go peacefully.

clean.tx: Ju détsch ùṣa gl unviarn cu bjèrs vèvan hald vacanzas scha … lò ampurtavi lu bétga scha té mavaṣ durònt l’ jamna né la … sòndaduméngj’ ajn sòrtida.
clean.tl: I say now that during winter when many people used to go on holidays … it wasn't important if one would go out during the week or during the weekend.

clean.tx: Cò èr’ adina … fulanau … ad i èr’ adina è … gè daplé lòcalitats, détsch ju ùṣa.
clean.tl: Here it was always … crowded … and there were always also … yes, more places, I say now.

clean.tx: Álṣò nus vèvan … gljèz èr’ è adin’ in tég autar tga quaj tga nus fajajn òz in téc.
clean.tl: Well, we had … that was always a bit different from what we do today, a bit.

clean.tx: Álṣò cu ju sùn vagnúṣ ò da scùla … nuṣ vèvan schòn è nátèls a da quaj ábar nus … nuṣ duvravan bétga schi … èxtrè̱m quaj scù i végn duvrau.
clean.tl: Well, when I finished school … we also had smartphones and such things, but we … we didn't use them in such an extreme way as they are used .

clean.tx: Pr̩ nuṣ vèvi adina nùm, nus santupajn … laṣ òtg séla majṣa radùnda … aschí vèndardís né sònda … tgi c’ è lò è lò.
clean.tl: For us it always meant that we meet … at eight o'clock at the round table … be it Friday or Saturday … whoever was there.

clean.tx: A lu al bjè stèv’ ins lò ina, duaṣ uras … da cumpignia api sjantar mav’ ins lu … ségi quaj ajn quèla bar né ajn tschèla … nùca tg’ i vèva lu tga trèva … dad ira.
clean.tl: And then we would mostly stay one or two hours together and then we would go into this bar or into that one … wherever it drew us to go.

clean.tx: Ábar anzatgí èra lu adina lò da laṣ òtg … sch’ ins vèva lu fatg gjù né bétg … par nuṣ vèvi adina nùm laṣ òtg lò.
clean.tl: But somebody was always there at eight o'clock … whether we had made an appointment or not … for us it always meant at eight there.

clean.tx: Ábar ùs ṣè quaj è samidau … álsò végni è scrèt drègj a saniastar.
clean.tl: But now this has changed … well, this is what one can read everywhere.

clean.tx: Álṣò ins mava par èxèmpal è magari gjù Lucèrn, pr̩quaj tga nuṣ vèvan gjù Lucèrn còlègs tga stèvan gjù lò.
clean.tl: Well, we would also go for instance to Lucerne because in Lucerne we had friends who lived down there.

clean.tx: Èra quaj pr̩ nus da quaj tjams schòn aun highlights … né … tga marschav’ in téc daplé, autra gljut … lu mav’ ins bugèn … né gjù Cuéra, gè … èxáct … a schjùc al bjè schòn sé cò antù̱rn.
clean.tl: For us these were indeed highlights at that time … right?

clean.tx: Ju vèv’ alṣ véntgatschún d’ avrèl nataléci a pauc sjanter èri dad ira.
clean.tl: I had my birthday on April 25 and a short time later I had to go .

clean.tx: Scha la scùla calava la sònda, scha gljèndiṣdís stèv’ inṣ í ajn plaza.
clean.tl: If school ended on Saturday, on Monday one had to start working.

clean.tx: A lu tòca gl òctò̱bar … gè, in' jè … in pèr diṣ avaun ca tga la scùl’ antschajva vèv’ ins finju.
clean.tl: And then until October … yes, once … some days before school started we could stop working.

clean.tx: Ábar quaj èra fétg strèng. Quaj stèv’ inṣ ira a … ju sùn stada navèn da l' ampréma classa … ajn plaza adina, tiar purs. Gè, quaj èra fétg hèfti.
clean.tl: But this was very strenuous.

clean.tx: Quaj mavas té a fumatgèsa a la pr̩mavèra èri da gidá cun grascha … bétar ò a gidá a pitgè quèla grascha, sa bigja scha té ancanùschas quaj, api èri dad í métar trúfals … api ….
clean.tl: Therefore you would go as a maid and during Spring one had to help with dung … spread out and help beating this dung, I don't know whether you know that, and then one had to sow potatoes … and … .

clean.tx: A las fèmnas stèv’ inṣ aun gidá a tgèsa a cu `ls ùmans mavan lu a … mavan aj lu a majṣès, scha quaj è da té ancanuschènt.
clean.tl: And the women, one had to help them at home and when the men would go and … would go up to the majṣès, if you know this.

clean.tx: Api schèvan aj … lu vèva las fèmnas da lavá ò la tgèsa … èri da lavá ò la tgès’ a gidá a … api èri dad í zarclá trúfals api èri dad í a zarclá al graun.
clean.tl: And they let … then the women had to clean the house … clean the house and help to … and then one had to weed the potato fields and then one had to go and weed the cereal fields.

clean.tx: Gè, quaj èr’ atgnamajn adina da fá, ju sùn è stada tiar purs nuc’ ju stuèva … cù dins … fá flucs.
clean.tl: Yes, that we had to do always, I also worked for farmers where I had to … how do you say?

clean.tx: Quaj èr’ al fajn tg’ èra rastauṣ anavù̱ṣ ajn iral, scha fagèvani quaj cun in ghítar flucs api vignéva quaj méz ajn ajn sacs a duvrau gl unviarn pr̩ dá dals pòrs.
clean.tl: That was the straw that remained on the threshing floor, then they would chop it with a grid and then this was put into sacks and used during winter to feed the pigs.

clean.tx: A sjantar mavan aj ad alp als tiars api vagnévi … vagnév’ als … als … purs lu anavù̱ṣ api èri da fá fajn.
clean.tl: And after this they would go to the summer pastures, the animals, and then the farmers … would … would come back and then one had to do hay.

clean.tx: I èra da quèls tga vèvan … . Ju sùn ùssa stada tiar dus purs tga vèvan mù vacas a … a lu quaj vagnéva tùt tratg cun bùvs, al fajn.
clean.tl: There were some that had … .

clean.tx: A quaj èra hèfti. Api tiar in pur sùnd ju stada tgu stuèva … ah … quaj èra mù ùm a dùna, quèls vèvan bigja gju famiglja a lu stuèv’ ju la sèra adin’ ir' a fá tschajna … a fá … manèstra, manèstra, manèstra, manèstra.
clean.tl: And this was strenuous.

clean.tx: Mav’ ju a tgèsa ábar quaj èra … èr’ ins trésts ajn in cèrt sèn api stgav’ ins lu bigja grad dí a tgèsa … í a tgès’ a dí tgé … còn hèfti inṣ vaj gju, gè … schjùc savilavan aj a quaj è ùssa mju ùm.
clean.tl: I would go home, but this was … one felt sad in a certain sense and then you couln't just say at home … go home and tell … how hard one had to work, yes … otherwise they would get angry, and this is now my husband.

clean.tx: Ina calira pi vèvani dau marjanda, scù nuṣ ṣchajn, api èri vagnú andamajn tg’ ins stuèva fá zitgé sén Ṣcharinas.
clean.tl: A terrible heath and they gave us a snack, as we say, and then they remembered that there was something to do up in Scharinas.

clean.tx: Sas tgé quaj vut dí? Quaj è ljung, quaj è sé Miléz, Ṣcharinas.
clean.tl: Do you know what this means?

clean.tx: Sé Miléz, dadajns Miléz …
clean.tl: Up at Milez, to the west of Milez … .

clean.tx: Ála finfinala vèv' ju stù fa in, ina … ina cumisjun a purtá ina dèpèscha.
clean.tl: In the end I had got a, a … a mission and had to deliver a message.

clean.tx: Quaj amblid’ ju bétg. Ju èr’ in gjuvanò̱tar, sùn maj staus fumègl ábar ins mav’ a gidá òra, pr̩quaj tga cu mju bap … duvrava buéts, èran quaj … èran quèls buéts, quèla famiglja … a quèls òn adina gidau al bap sch’ i dumandavan a lu ṣchèv’ al bap: «Sch’ als PN damòndan … in ò dad ira.»
clean.tl: This I'll never forget.

clean.tx: Basta. In' jèda vagnév’ in, in' jèda tschèl … ábar schagliuc bèn, èran aj ….
clean.tl: OK.

clean.tx: Gljèdṣ va ju è gju, quaj èr’ uschéja … ábar inṣ èra, gè, bjè jèdas trésts a tartgava, ò djantarajn … ábar a tgèsa stgav’ ins bétg’ ira a dí, pr̩quaj tg’ i ṣchèvan: «Ò quaj pùs té schòn, ùṣa quaj è nuéta schi nausch.»
clean.tl: This I also had, this was so … but we were … yes, many times sad and thought, have in between … but at home we were not allowed to go and tell , because they would say: «Oh, you are certainly able to do that, now this is not so bad».

clean.tx: Ábar té, a gè, api lu mavan ins tùta stat, lò vèva da fá quaj.
clean.tl: But you, and yes, and then we would go for the whole summer, there had to do that.

clean.tx: A sch’ i èra malaura, scha vèv’ inṣ a tgèsa da fá, las fèmnas, lu èri da zarclá agl iart a fá quaj a fá tschaj.
clean.tl: And if the weather was bad, we, the women, had to work in the house, then we had to weed the garden and do this and do that.

clean.tx: A … api èri puspè dad í sél fùns, cu i èra dad ira puspè … gè.
clean.tl: And … and then we had to go to the fields again when it was to go again … yes.

clean.tx: Ábar tgé tga … tg’ ins discussjunèsch’ aun anqual jèda, c’ in èra buéts … ju sa tg’ ju sùn stauṣ vazlè, tgé èra quaj, trènta vadjals … gjù cò vi da tschèla vart, ábar … ju sa bitg sch’ ju mav’ a scùla né uschéja.
clean.tl: But what … what one still discusses sometimes, when we were boys … I know that I was a calf herdsman, how many were there, thirty calves … down here, over there on the other side, but … I don't know whether I was going to school or so.

clean.tx: Ábar quaj vagnéva dau ṣura in pènṣum mèmi gròn ad ju sùn parschuadjus, è ad alp … pia sch’ in èra purtgè, sùn staus purtgè cun dùdiṣch òns, a vèva mju quántum vacas.
clean.tl: But they would give us too much homework and I am convinced, also to the pasture … therefore if one was a swineherd, I was swineherd when I was twelve years old, and I had my amount of cows.

clean.tx: Ju vèva da trá la cèntrifuga … né, quaj tùt tga mungèva … quaj èra zagnún, pástar gròn ….
clean.tl: I had to spin the centrifuge … right, here everybody had to milk … there were the alpine dairyman, the main shepherd … .

clean.tx: Álṣò bigja dal tùt trajtschi̱an, craj ju bétg … ábar ah … plé damanajval da trajtschi̱an tga da duatschi̱an tschuncònta.
clean.tl: Well, not exactly 300, I don't believe … but eh … nearer to 300 than to 250.

clean.tx: A lur’ èra quaj al zagnún api al pástar, vèva quaj, a vèva è sju quántum vacaṣ da … da mùngjar.
clean.tl: And then there were the dairyman and the herdsman, that had, and also had his amount of cows to … to milk.

clean.tx: Quaj … in stèva vagní … mintgín sén sju quántum, quèls vèvan fòrsa végn vacas a `l zagnún vèva fòrsa ṣchòtg a `l tarségl vèva quindisch … al pástar … pin, i èra dus pástars, vèva fòrsa dùdisch, a `l purtgè vèv’ è aun òtg né déjsch.
clean.tl: This … one had to reach … everyone their amount, those had maybe twenty cows and the dairyman had maybe eighteen and the assistant fifteen … the second … herdsman, there were two herdsmen, had maybe twelve and the swineherd, in addition, also had eight or ten.

clean.tx: A i èra … tùt anzjaman èr’ in sis parsunas. Quèls vèvan da mùngjar las vacas … la … las tschian vacas … lajn dí ùssa, mù òtgònta … òtgònta vacas, la damaun a la sèra.
clean.tl: And there were … all together six people.

clean.tx: A … a quaj òn tgu sùn staus purtgè sél cuélm … quaj è stau ana tschuncòntatschún.
clean.tl: And … and that year, when I was swineherd at the majṣès … this was in 1955.

clean.tx: Ju craj tgu vèvi òtg vacas a … a lu vèvani ábar fatg uschéa:
clean.tl: I think I had eight cows, and … and then they did it the following way:

clean.tx: «Té as … al zagnún a tauntaṣ a tauntas, a té as da gidá lèz. Vuṣ duṣ vajṣ da … mùngjar.»
clean.tl: «You have … the dairyman has so and so many, and you have to help him.

clean.tx: A quaj èra lu è détg: «Té as laṣ vacaṣ dal Berther, té as quèlaṣ dal Caduff.» A quaj èra sé las nùdas … quaj ancanuschèvas … mintga vaca.
clean.tl: And they would also say this: «You take Berther's cows, you take Caduff's cows.» And that was on the brands … so you could recognise … every cow.

clean.tx: Álṣò tòc’ al davùṣ da la stat … ancanuschèvas la buṣchia dal pur da laṣ vacas. Mintga pur vèva sia buṣchia, a quaj vèvanṣ da fá.
clean.tl: Well, until the end of summer … you knew the nickname of every farmer of the cows.

clean.tx: A lur’ `l purtgè vèv’ aun … cu i mungèvan, mávani ajn a dargèvan gjù al … al latg ála cùpa da la cèntrifuga a quèl’ èra da trá … trá, trá … tùt al latg cèntrifugau.
clean.tl: And then the swineherd had to … when they were milking, they would go in and pour the … the milk into the bowl of the centrifuge and we had to pull … pull, pull … the whole centrifuged milk.

clean.tx: Api magari vèva `l aun da tanaj laṣ vacaṣ ajn stával. Quaj vul dí culas, quèls tiars dal gjával tga mavan òra … autras stèvan lò duaṣ uras, fagèvan bigja mucs, ábar i èr’ adina zacòntas tga mavan, da las vacas … api stuèvanṣ í: «Puscha … puscha … las vacas vòn!»
clean.tl: And sometimes he also had to maintain the cows in the cowshed.

clean.tx: Pi èri da schè … quaj èra … da samazá da trá ajn la cèntrifuga, quaj duvrava grònda fòrza … cu `l èr’ in' jèd’ ajn, mava quaj pulit … ábar al trá ajn èla èra … da maz.
clean.tl: Then one had to let … that was … terrible to bring in the centrifuge, this required much force … when once it was in, it was easy to handle it … but bringing it in was … terrible.

clean.tx: Quaj cas stù ju raquintá. Quaj èra in pulit ùm, ò cò da Zarcúns. Ju vèz’ aun quèl, quaj èr’ in súpar musicant … in ùm pin griaṣ usché, ábar in … in pin.
clean.tl: I should tell the following case.

clean.tx: A sjantar èra, mav’ als tiars puspè a pastgè a lura stèv’ al … al zagnún, lèz caṣchava, sjantar cargjav’ al magnùc a purtava ajn tschalè.
clean.tl: And after this one had to, the animals would again go and graze and then the … the alpine dairyman had to, he would make cheese, and after that he would load the cheese and bring it to the cellar.

clean.tx: Quaj èra in … tgilada gjù val, ajn in' autra alp, in … in liuc cèntrau pr̩ duaṣ alps. A lura al, als pástars mavan cùls tiars, al … al purtgè a ‘l tarségl vèvan dad èssar ajn … ajn tégja a buglí gjù, sas, lu fá la … la scòtga.
clean.tl: That was a … slip down the valley, into another alpine pasture, a … a central place for two pastures.

clean.tx: Lu vagnéva fatg tschagrún. Cu `l latg èra tratgs òra, scha l’ ò `l … al zignún finju, api cargjav’ al al magnùc da la … dal dé avaun né da la sèr’ avaun a cargjava a … purtava ajn tschalè.
clean.tl: Then they made whey cheese.

clean.tx: A dantaun stèvaṣ buglí sé al, la scòtga, quaj stèvaṣ … quaj duvrava la plé bjè lèna … quaj stèva buglí.
clean.tl: And meanwhile one had to boil up the, the the whey, this one had to … that required the highest quantity of firewood … the whey had to boil.

clean.tx: Quaj è uschéa, ju èr’ in buéb da nùv né déjṣch òns ad avaun òns ṣè quaj clar tga scùla èri mù gl unviarn.
clean.tl: This is so, I was a boy of nine or ten years, and years ago it is clear that we attended school only during winter.

clean.tx: La stat … èra simplamajn bigja scùla. Quaj gnang vèva nùm vacanzas. La stat … èra nagina scùla.
clean.tl: During summer … there was simply no school.

clean.tx: La scùla finéva … al matg … zarcladur, ad ins ṣchèva da quaj bigj èxnùm vacanzas. Sjantar èri bigja scùla, líbar.
clean.tl: School ended in May … June, and one wouldn't necessarily call this holidays.

clean.tx: A … cò mava `lṣ buéts la stad ad alp, ábar avaun c’ al tjams dad alp èri lu aun dad í majṣès … culs tiars.
clean.tl: And … here, during summer, the boys would go to the summer pastures, but before going to the summer pastures one had to go to the majṣès with the animals.

clean.tx: A … nuṣ vèvan par èxèmpal al majṣès ajnta Pardatsch, in autar vèva sé Miléz né Val Gjuf né nù c’ i èran èra.
clean.tl: And … we had our majṣès in Pardatsch, somebody else had it in Milez or Val jiuv or wherever they were.

clean.tx: Scadín cas, quaj èra schòn … ah … in désidéri, savaj í majṣès a durmí sé lò. Tùt símpal, ins savèva gidá ajn tégj’ a cuṣchiná a vi a nò.
clean.tl: In any case, this was indeed … eh … a longing, be able to go to the majṣès and sleep up there.

clean.tx: Api quaj è usché tga … al bap … vagnéva … als ùmans, quaj èr’ aun plé purs lò … . Nuṣ vèvan da partgirá als tiars, als buéts, a stèvan lò sé, sé majṣès.
clean.tl: But this is so that … my father … would come … the men, there still were more farmers there … .

clean.tx: A … in èra fumègl tiar quèl, tschèl èra fòrza … in pur, èfèctív al fégl, api …, ábar savènṣ è aun da quèls tg’ èran fumègl tschò né lò.
clean.tl: And … one was a farmhand for that person, the other was maybe ..

clean.tx: Ad ju èra tial bap. Quaj èra naturálmajn flòt. Scha lu ò quaj dau òns tg’ ins stèv’ ira … cul fagòt … tiar in pur a gidá.
clean.tl: And I was with my father.

clean.tx: A quaj òn vèva `l détg: «Ah uòn nò té ajnta Pardatsch.» Al PN, mju frá, èr’ juṣ ajn in autar ljuc.
clean.tl: And that year he had said: «Eh, this year go to Pardatsch.» PN, my brother, had gone to another place.

clean.tx: Scadín cas, a vagnévan … i ajn culs tiars, api … alṣ ùmans … durmévan lò, mungjèvan a mavan a tgèsa … ah la damaun.
clean.tl: In any case, and they came … up with the animals, and … the men … would sleep there, they would milk and would go home … eh … the next morning.

clean.tx: Api ancù̱ntar sèra, las quátar, las tschun vagnévani sédò puspè ad usché vinavaun. Al dé ò èran nus parsuls.
clean.tl: And towards evening, at four o'clock, five o'clock they would come up again and so on.

clean.tx: Alṣ ùmans mavan cul latg gjù tgèsa a quaj èra … in' ur’ a paj bjabé̱gn. A scadín cas … pr̩ndèv’ al bap lur’ ajn tiar quaj gjantá tg’ ins duvrava magnùc a tgarnpiartg.
clean.tl: The men would go home with the milk and that would take them a good hour on foot.

clean.tx: Quaj vèv’ inṣ adina, ábar quaj èra tga `l purtava fòrz’ ajn: «Ò la mùma ò fatg ina péta.», né, né, ina tgaussa né l’ autra tg’ ins salagrava lura.
clean.tl: This we always had, but it could happen that maybe he brought here: «Oh, mother has made a cake.», right?

clean.tx: Ùṣa, in' jèda … stù fòrz’ aun dí òdavaun, mintga buéb vèva … tarmagljava cul cuntí da sac … tgapiala … a cuntí da sac. A … ju sa tga ju vèva bégja cuntí … né usché in tgu schèv’ ajn tégja.
clean.tl: Now, once … I might say in advance, every boy had … would play with the pocket knife … hat … and pocket knife.

clean.tx: Quaj èra lu nuéta propi … quaj cuntí èra … scadín cas … ah … èra quaj ina sònda sèra … al bab végn sé majṣès … api cò … sacadò̱s … quaj tg’ ins stù vaj: macrúnṣ a riṣ a quaj a tschaj.
clean.tl: This was nothing really … this knife was … anyhow … eh this happened on a Saturday afternoon … my father comes up to the … and here … backpack … what one must have: rice, macaroni and this and that.

clean.tx: Ad ju, quétun cun quèla sèrvla, má tga quaj èra ina raritat … quaj dèvi bigja grat. A … la dumèngja … alṣ ùmanṣ èn i angjù̱ … alṣ buéts èran ṣur tégja … a:
clean.tl: And I, braggart with that cervelat, because that was something scarce … that you wouldn't find just so.

clean.tx: «Tgé fas té gjantá?» «Tgé as té?» In vèva survagnú pèta a … ad ju … «Ju a survagnú ina sèrvala.» «Schòn?» Quaj èra scartèzja.
clean.tl: «What are you going to prepare for lunch?» «What do you have?» One had got a cake and … and I … «I have got a cervelat.» «Really?» The cervelats were very scarce.

clean.tx: A ‘l PN …: «Vò gjù in' jèda par quèla sèrvla!» Ad ju séglja gjù ajn tégja a végn sé cun èla … a gljèz … mirau a mirau, i èra bigj' aun uraṣ da gjantá.
clean.tl: And …: «Go down and fetch that cervelat!» And I run down to the hut and come up with it … and that … looked and looked, it wasn't yet time for lunch.

clean.tx: Api prènd’ al PN in cuntí ò da sac … quèls cuntjalṣ da mòni mèlan … usché, lajn dí, in cuntí da pauc, al mèndar èra mù tga quèl vèv’ ajn ina stria furclèta, api fò ‘l:
clean.tl: And then PN takes a knife out of his pocket … one of those knives with a yellow handle … so, let's say, a worthless knife; the worst was that it had a damned notch and then he said:

clean.tx: «Atgnamajn lès ju bratá … . Té sas vaj al cuntí par adina a té datas da mé la sèrvòla.»
clean.tl: «Actually I would like to exchange … .

clean.tx: Ad ju mirau sén quaj cuntí … buah …, ò gljèz, in cuntí fùs schòn … . A … la sèrvòla dèv’ ju schòn nuídis.
clean.tl: And I looked at this knife … wow!

clean.tx: «PN, té saṣ vaj la sèrvòla …. Ju salv’ al cuntí.» Stau ditg a fatg … ju vèva schòn quajdas, ábar quaj èra … ad ju, gl’ amprém tgu a fatg … è í in téc zanúa a ṣ ad í in téc.
clean.tl: , you can have the cervelat … .

clean.tx: A ṣè quaj stau fatg cun quaj … ju mét’ al cuntí ajn sac. A la sèra végn al bap sédò da las quátar …, nuṣ vajn mùgnṣch a fatg tùt quèlas lavurs.
clean.tl: And then this was done … I put the knife into my pocket.

clean.tx: A sjantar … las sjat, laṣ òtg èr’ ins avaun tégja, èr’ aun ditg clar ad in téc als buéts … . Scadín caṣ èr’ ju lò pr̩suls cul bap.
clean.tl: And after … at seven, eight we were in front of the hut, it was still clear for a long time and the boys a bit … .

clean.tx: Al bap … anvidau sé cò ina stùmpa scù adina, ad ju prèn òra quaj cuntí a ṣ cò zatgé api mir’ al bab via sén mè:
clean.tl: My father … lit up a cheroot up here as always, and I take out that knife and carve here something and then my father looks over to me:

clean.tx: «Tgé … tgé as té lò?» «Ò ju a in …» «Da tgi as quaj cuntí?» «Ah quèl va ju survagnú.» «Lá mirá in' jèda!» … Vau dau via … api détg èl: «Símplamajn survagnú èl uschéa?»
clean.tl: «What … what do you have there?» «Oh I have a … «Whom do you have this knife from?» «Eh this one I have received.» «Let see it!» … I gave it over … and then he said: «Just got it like this?»

clean.tx: «Na, ju a stju … ju a stju dá la sèrvòla, brat’ ò.» Al bap ò détg nuét. Ju va tartgau … bigja bjè … nuét.
clean.tl: «No, I had … I had to give the cervelat, exchange .» My father didn't say anything.

clean.tx: «Ò scha lura, sas té tgé, PN? Vò sé a tùrna quaj cuntí dal PN. Quaj è lu è bigj’ in … quaj è par safá mal. Na, quaj vala nuét.»
clean.tl: Oh well then, do you know what, PN?

clean.tx: «Ah gljèz … ju a schòn è quitau, na èfèctíf, na.» Ju sùn jus sé a détg dal PN … fòrza l’ autar dé … gljèz sa ju bégja … turnau al cuntí. Ju a détg:
clean.tl: «Eh that … I also thought, no, effectively, no.» I went up and told PN … maybe the following day … I don't know it … gave back the knife.

clean.tx: «Té, quaj è tùt ajn ùrdan, ábar quaj cuntí cò, quaj è bigja … fòrz’ aprècjèschas té èl plé fétg tgu. Ju tégn da quèl lò … è bétga, quaj sau è bigja pròpi dulatschè.»
clean.tl: «Listen, this is all OK, but this knife, this isn't … maybe you appreciate it more than I do.

clean.tx: Quaj è stau la … duméngj’ èra al bab vagnúṣ anòra a la dumèngja sèra ṣè quaj stau; èl vò anò gljéndiṣdíṣ andamaun.
clean.tl: This was … on Sunday my father had come up and this took place on Sunday afternoon; he goes back Monday morning.

clean.tx: A la sèra da las quátar végn al anajn. «PN, ò, nuét, ò ju sùn aun in' jèda.» A prènd èl ò dal sacadò̱s in cuntí réjsch néjv da mòni mèlan … èxáct al madèm.
clean.tl: And in the afternoon, at four, he comes up.

clean.tx: Cù `l bab è jus navèn da Cavòrgja sé Sadrún, cù `l ò òrganisau quaj cuntí … má tga quaj èra bigja schi símpal, in cuntí vèv’ ins bigja grad sén cruna.
clean.tl: How my father went from Cavorgia up to Sedrun, how he organised this knife … because it was not so simple, you don't just have a knife on the rack.

clean.tx: A quèla luṣchèzja, quaj va ju aprazjau énòrm … tg’ al bap … ò sènza nuét … sènza dí in plajd cuntí … l’ autar dé in cuntí réjsch néjv … èxáct al madèm, da mòni mèlan.
clean.tl: And this proudness, I appreciated enormously that my father … had without anything, without saying a word … the next day a brand-new knife … exactly the same, with a yellow handle.

clean.tx: A … quaj è zatgé tgu a maj amblidau.
clean.tl: And … this is something I have never forgotten.
